title: Send Discord message
description: Posts a message to a Discord channel through a webhook. Mentions (@everyone, @here, users, roles) never ping.

connectionId.title: Discord connection
connectionId.description: Discord connection holding the channel's webhook URL.

content.title: Message
content.description: Message text, at most 2000 characters after mappings are applied.

username.title: Sender name
username.description: Optional name shown instead of the webhook's own, at most 80 characters.
